description:
## Changes
- Fix `VideoTimeReferenceFingerprint` failures with Morphe Patcher 2, including Morphe Manager 2.2.0 and current official Morphe patches.
- Match the playback-time log prefix explicitly instead of relying on the legacy partial-string matching behavior that changed in Patcher 2.
- Keep the playback-time call selection and existing playback-speed compatibility fix.
- Update English, Korean and Japanese installation/update instructions.

## Validation
- Reproduced the 1.3.2 fingerprint failure on the unmodified YouTube 21.20.405 APK with Morphe Patches 1.48.0.
- Applied Morphe Patches 1.48.0 and bundle 1.3.3 together with Morphe Desktop 1.19.1: all 105 selected patches succeeded and APK rebuilding completed.
- Ten fingerprint regression tests passed with the existing Patcher runtime; the five new playback-time tests also passed with the current Patcher runtime.
- Built the Android-compatible `.mpp` with `classes.dex` and the bundled extension.
- Device playback and YouTube 21.04.223 were not retested.

## Update / 업데이트
In Morphe, open Sources, select **Niconico YT Comments Patches**, and tap **Update**. Confirm bundle version **1.3.3**, then patch the unmodified YouTube **21.20.405** APK again with the official Morphe patches.

Morphe의 **Sources → Niconico YT Comments Patches → Update**에서 **1.3.3**으로 갱신한 뒤, 원본 YouTube **21.20.405** APK에 공식 Morphe 패치와 함께 다시 적용하세요. 기존 원격 주소를 그대로 사용할 수 있습니다.

Remote source: https://github.com/david419kr/niconico-yt-morphe-patches

For a local source, download `patches-1.3.3.mpp` and replace the previous local source.
